يتباين (form VI)
# يَتَبَايَنُ (yatabāyanu) /ja.ta.baː.ja.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَايَنَ (tabāyana)
# يَتَبَايَنَّ (yatabāyanna) /ja.ta.baː.jan.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَبَايَنَ (tabāyana)
# يُتَبَايَنُ (yutabāyanu) /ju.ta.baː.ja.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
